description: This file sets up and runs a conversational AI bot using Pipecat framework, integrating speech processing, environment configuration, and a Gemini Live LLM service, with event handlers for client connection and disconnection.

classes.name: GeminiLiveLLMService
classes.description: A service class for interacting with Gemini Live LLM API, configured with API key, system instructions, and voice ID.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Represents a processing pipeline composed of multiple steps including input, LLM, and output.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: Encapsulates a pipeline execution with parameters and manages its lifecycle.

classes.name: PipelineRunner
classes.description: Handles running the pipeline, including signal handling and execution control.

methods.name: run_bot
methods.description: Initializes and runs the AI bot pipeline with event handlers for client connection and disconnection.

methods.name: bot
methods.description: Main entry point for the bot, creates transport and starts the bot process.
